projects.name: TwitchSentry
projects.text: TwitchSentry is a fully automated moderation suite designed for quiet and crowded chats. It can replace a human moderator in small communities and works great as a backup in big ones.
projects.keys: A moderation suite for Streamer.bot: deletes fake gift links, sketchy URLs and copy-paste scams in Twitch chat, guards against raids and follow waves, and tells you what was removed and why. Twitch Discord Stoat GameVox ntfy Windows TwitchSentry

projects.name: Better Stream Announcements
projects.text: Automatically announce your and your friend's livestream on Discord, Stoat, GameVox.
projects.keys: Go-live and stream-ended announcements in Discord, Stoat or GameVox for your own channel and your streamer friends, with slash commands and a settings window. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Owncast, Rumble, Picarto and TikTok. Twitch YouTube Kick Owncast Rumble Picarto TikTok Discord Stoat GameVox Better-Stream-Announcements

projects.name: SBRefFix
projects.text: Fixes the broken .NET references in a Streamer.bot v1.0.7 export.
projects.keys: Fixes the .NET references in a Streamer.bot export, so the import compiles on every PC, wherever Streamer.bot is installed. A small PowerShell tool for Windows. Windows PowerShell SBRefFix

projects.name: Suggestions To
projects.text: Your chat has good ideas but you always struggle to remember them? Now your chat can write them down for you!
projects.keys: SuTo for Streamer.bot: viewers type !suggestion in Twitch, YouTube or Kick chat, and the idea lands in your Discord, Stoat or GameVox server with their name, platform and the time. Twitch YouTube Kick Discord Stoat GameVox SuTo

projects.name: OBS Notes
projects.text: Can't remember the code of the combination lock? Your chat can step in and add a post-it in OBS for you!
projects.keys: OBS Notes for Streamer.bot: viewers write codes, quest hints and names into Twitch, YouTube or Kick chat with !note, and each note sticks on stream as a post-it, one list per game. Twitch YouTube Kick OBS overlay OBSNotes

projects.name: GameCheck
projects.text: Send embeds to discord to inform about Games, Demos, DLCs, etc. for free or on sale for any platform (PC, Console, Handheld, Mobile)
projects.keys: GameCheck for Streamer.bot: free games, DLC, loot and demos from Steam, Epic, GOG, Prime Gaming and more, plus the running store sales and the top deals per store, in Discord messages that keep themselves up to date. Discord GameCheck

projects.name: Chat Calendar
projects.text: Create your own calendar that display holidays, birthdays or other custom special days in your chat!
projects.keys: Chat Calendar for Streamer.bot: greets your Twitch, YouTube and Kick chat on public holidays of 100+ countries, birthdays and your own special days, and posts them to Discord, Stoat or GameVox. Twitch YouTube Kick Discord Stoat GameVox ChatCalendar

projects.name: AutoBotCheck
projects.text: Three separate Actions that goes through public bot lists and bans any bot that is not already banned in your Twitch channel.
projects.keys: AutoBotCheck for Streamer.bot: bans the accounts on the TwitchInsights, TwitchBots.info and ISDS bot lists in your Twitch channel. Later runs only ban the new ones, and mods, VIPs, service bots and your whitelist are never banned. Twitch AutoBotCheck

projects.name: Blackjack Game
projects.text: You don't need to go to Las Vegas to play solid Strip Poker! Play against the CPU, another Player or together against the House on stream with an OBS Overlay!
projects.keys: A real hand of Blackjack against the dealer in chat, with splits, double downs and insurance, or a duel between two chatters. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick OBS overlay Blackjack-Game

projects.name: Classic Chat Gamble
projects.text: The most classic stream chat game ever! Highly customizable and always up to zero your balance!
projects.keys: The classic chat gamble: bet with numbers, keywords or percentages, chase jackpots, or run it on Twitch channel points. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick Classic-Chat-Gamble

projects.name: Trivia Game
projects.text: Ready to put your knowledge to the test? Let's see how you work under pressure!
projects.keys: Quiz rounds straight in chat, with questions from the Open Trivia Database, your own list or both, plus blitz rounds and viewer suggestions. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick Trivia-Game

projects.name: Slot Machine Game
projects.text: Who needs a casino if you can play your slots right here in the chat? Spin the wheels and reach for the Jackpot!
projects.keys: Chat spins the reels with emotes: adjustable odds, three to six reels, rare emotes pay more, and an optional jackpot pool. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick Slot-Machine-Game

projects.name: Hangman Game
projects.text: One of the most iconic Pencil&Paper games. But the future is now, we play in OBS not on paper!
projects.keys: Hangman for the whole chat: one word, a row of blanks and everyone guessing at once, while the OBS overlay draws the gallows. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick OBS overlay Hangman-Game

projects.name: Battleship Game
projects.text: One of the iconic Pencil&Paper games now also available in chat and OBS overlay with heat click support!
projects.keys: Battleship on stream: chat commands a fleet against the Admiral, a CPU opponent that never sees your board, on a grid drawn live in OBS. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick OBS overlay Battleship-Game

projects.name: RhymeTime
projects.text: Does your chat have a way with words? One word, a ticking clock, and a rhyme that pays!
projects.keys: A word to rhyme with, a clock and a few attempts: chat stakes points and answers in ordinary chat, rhymes nobody listed count too, and the OBS overlay carries the word, the clock and the rhyme that won it. A Streamer.bot extension for Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Twitch YouTube Kick OBS overlay RhymeTime
